KGhost races you against a single ghost along your route. On stretches you have ridden before, the ghost is your past self (Race Your Own); everywhere else it keeps moving at the Ghost Pace below. The two combine into one continuous ghost over the whole ride.
Fixed pace used when no route is loaded, and to fill the parts of a route where you have no recorded history.
Could not save. Please try again.
Master switch. When off, KGhost does nothing on any profile — no ghost, no recording, no alerts.
Archive near-duplicate recorded rides (keep the fastest and two most recent of each route) so ghosts stay solid. Archived rides move to /sdcard/KGhost/tracks/archive and are recoverable.
Each Karoo ride profile can use its own Ghost Pace base, or follow the global one above. Profiles appear here after you ride or open settings with them selected.

Race against your past self on stretches of the route you have ridden before.
Enable racing against recorded history when a matching route is loaded.
Race a constant target pace, or your own recorded rides on the route. Picking Fixed pace disables the Your-rides options below.
Which past ride to use when multiple tracks cover the same stretch.

Average races the recency-weighted mean of your recent laps of the loaded route (long stops don\'t count). It needs a couple of laps started at the route start before it kicks in; stretches without enough laps race your Best instead. Only the first lap of each ride counts.
Automatically save each ride as a GPS track for future ghost comparison.
Show an alert when entering a stretch with a recorded ghost.
Show an alert when leaving a stretch with a recorded ghost. When the next stretch is close, the exit is skipped so nearby stretches don\'t double-alert.

Save KGhost\'s diagnostics to a file so a ride can be studied afterwards without a computer. Each ride gets its own file (kghost-YYYY-MM-dd-HHmmss.log); older files are purged automatically once there are more than 6. Leave off for normal use, debug increase battery usage and general performance.

Heads up: when on, the diagnostic log is also sent to the developer to help fix issues. GPS coordinates and route/profile names are removed before sending — no location or identity leaves your Karoo. It is tagged only by a random Anon tag (no personal data; shown below when on) so logs can be grouped — quote it if you report a problem. Off = nothing is sent.
Draw the ghost\'s live position on the map during a segment race
Drop GPX or FIT files in /sdcard/KGhost/ to import them as ghost tracks.

Important: without all-files access KGhost can\'t load any ghosts. Grant it so KGhost can read your recorded rides from /sdcard/FitFiles and the files you drop in /sdcard/KGhost. If you grant it while the app is open, the ghosts load on your next ride.
